visible_turns.text: What did you do last night ?
Did you watch the Barcelona versus Madrid game ?
What were the results of the game ?
Really ? I thought Barcelona was going to win . They are a much better team than Madrid .
That was the last game before the playoffs .
In a few weeks . Are you planning on watching them ?

atoms.claim: The target watched or has knowledge of the Barcelona versus Madrid game results
The target provided information that explained something to the observer
B told A something about the game results that surprised A (contradicting A's expectation that Barcelona would win)
B provided information about the result of the Barcelona versus Madrid game that surprised A.
B asked when the playoffs are scheduled to take place
B gave an explanation for what happened during or regarding the game that A acknowledged.
B provided an explanation for the game outcome that A accepted as sufficient
